_schema_guide.description: Dynamically Defined Local Identifier (LID) Train Composition Schema Guide (ISO 14230-3). BMWP2000 4.0.0 polls every LID with '21 <LID>' at the poll rate; the 'transmission_mode' key is no longer supported and makes the definition invalid.

keys.name: Descriptive human-readable name string (e.g., 'engineCore', 'boostAir').
keys.cids: Array of CID string keys referenced in sequence order from master cids.json.
